blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal rumor detectors increasingly rely on retrieved evidence, yet relevant evidence is not necessarily sufficient for verification. Missing provenance, duplicated reports, and unresolved contradictions can produce confident predictions without adequate support. We introduce SAFE-MR, a framework that separates claim veracity from evidence sufficiency. The method decomposes image–text posts into verifiable claims, constructs a relation-aware claim–evidence graph, and aggregates evidence using provenance and contextual compatibility. Separate veracity and sufficiency heads support selective prediction, while evidence interventions encourage stability under irrelevant additions and sensitivity to evidence removal. On NewsCLIPpings, VERITE, and XFacta, SAFE-MR achieves macro-F1 scores of 91.2%, 75.8%, and 85.2%, respectively. Against the matched backbone with evidence, its macro-F1 gains are 2.2, 4.9, and 4.8 percentage points. On the diagnostic selection set, SAFE-MR reduces AURC from 0.105 for maximum-probability rejection to 0.075 and lowers error at 80% coverage from 13.8% to 8.5%. Evidence-perturbation and ablation results support the role of sufficiency learning and intervention training in improving selective verification.
blocks.zh: 多式联运谣言探测器越来越依赖取回的证据,但相关证据不一定足以进行核查。 缺少出处、重复的报告和尚未解决的矛盾,在没有充分支持的情况下,可以产生自信的预测。 我们引入了SFE-MR,这个框架将声称真实性与证据的充分性区分开来. 这种方法将图像-文本帖子分解为可核实的索赔,构建了一个了解关系的索赔-证据图表,并利用出处和背景相容性汇总了证据。 单独的真实性和充分性头支持有选择的预测,而证据干预则鼓励在不相干地添加证据和敏感度下实现稳定性。 在NewsCLIPpings,VERITE,和XFacta上,SAFE-MR分别实现了91.2%,75.8%和85.2%的宏F1分. 对照有证据的配套骨干,其宏观-F1收益为2.2、4.9和4.8个百分点。 在诊断选择中,SAFE-MR将最大概率拒绝的AURC从0.105降低到0.075,并将80%的覆盖率误差从13.8%降低到8.5%. 证据干扰和破坏结果支持充分学习和干预培训在改进选择性核查方面的作用。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Authentic images can be repurposed to support false descriptions of when, where, or why an event occurred. Such out-of-context misinformation is difficult to detect from visual appearance alone: a flood photograph may be genuine even when its location and date are false. A detector must determine whether the image supports the specific contextual claim, rather than merely whether the image and text concern similar topics. Throughout this paper, multimodal rumor detection refers to image–text veracity assessment; it does not imply that every unverified rumor is false.
blocks.zh: 真实图像可以被重新用于支持对事件发生的时间,地点或原因的虚假描述. 这种内容外的错误信息很难从视觉外观中发现:一幅洪水相片即使位置和日期都是假的,也可能是真实的. 探测器必须确定图像是否支持具体的上下文要求,而不仅仅是图像和文本是否涉及类似的主题. 在本文中,多式联运谣言检测是指图像-文字真实性评估;这并不意味着每个未经核实的谣言都是虚假的。

blocks.en: External retrieval offers a way to recover missing context. Evidence can reveal an image’s earlier publication or establish the identity of a depicted event. However, retrieved pages may repeat the claim under investigation, omit decisive details, or disagree about the event. The number of matching pages is especially misleading when several pages copy a single source. Consequently, evidence relevance, source independence, and evidence sufficiency must be distinguished.
blocks.zh: 外部检索提供了一个恢复缺失上下文的方法. 证据可以揭示一个图像的早期出版,或者确定被描绘出的事件的身份. 然而,检索到的网页可能会重复正在调查的主张,省略决定性的细节,或者对事件有不同意见. 匹配的页面数量在多页复制单一来源时特别误导. 因此,必须区分证据的相关性、来源的独立性和证据的充分性。

blocks.en: Recent methods provide strong foundations for evidence-based detection. SNIFFER investigates explainable out-of-context detection with multimodal language models ( Qi et al., 2024 ) ; E2LVLM reorganizes retrieved evidence for model-based verification ( Wu et al., 2025 ) ; TRUST-VL studies general misinformation detection across distortion types ( Yan et al., 2025a ) . Meanwhile, simple multimodal similarity features remain competitive on established benchmarks ( Papadopoulos et al., 2025 ) . These observations motivate evaluation beyond conventional accuracy: a system can exploit retrieval similarity without establishing whether the decisive factual proposition is supported.
blocks.zh: 最近的方法为基于证据的侦查提供了坚实的基础。 SNIFFER用多模式语言模型(Qi等,2024年)调查了可解释的文本外检测;E2LVLM重组了取回的证据,用于模型核查(Wu等,2025年);TRUST-VL研究了跨扭曲类型的一般错误检测(Yan等,2025年a年)。 与此同时,简单的多式联运相似性在既定基准上仍然具有竞争力(帕帕佐普洛斯等,2025年)。 这些意见刺激了超出常规准确度的评价:一个系统可以利用检索的相似性,而不确定决定性的事实主张是否得到支持。

blocks.en: Consider the constructed mismatch in Figure 1 , which uses a real aerial flood image. The deliberately incorrect caption attributes it to City A in 2025. A topical report alone does not establish the image’s location or date. The source record instead identifies the mosaic as imagery of Mabi, Kurashiki, Japan, photographed by the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan on 9 July 2018 and subsequently assembled into a mosaic. This provenance refutes the proposed 2025 attribution. The claim’s underlying truth has not changed; the evidence available to the verifier has changed. A conflicting repost does not invalidate decisive provenance evidence. This is a constructed illustration, not a documented social-media rumor or an evaluated model prediction.
blocks.zh: 考虑图1中构建的错配, 故意错误的字幕在2025年将其归属于City A. 仅凭专题报告并不能确定图像的位置或日期。 源出记录取而代之地将马赛克确定为日本仓桥基地马比的影像,由日本地理空间信息局于2018年7月9日拍摄并随后组装为马赛克. 这一来源驳斥了拟议的2025年归属. 申诉所依据的真相没有改变;核查人掌握的证据已经改变。 相互矛盾的重新公布并不使决定性的出处证据失效。 这是一个构建的插图,不是有记录的社会媒体谣言,也不是评价模型预测.

blocks.en: We propose SAFE-MR to operationalize this distinction. It learns separate representations for veracity and evidence sufficiency, using atomic claims as the interface between image–text understanding and evidence reasoning. An intervention objective teaches the model which changes should preserve its output and which should reduce its willingness to decide. This is a controlled robustness objective, not a claim of identifying real-world causal effects.
blocks.zh: 我们建议安全监测、监测、报告和跟踪系统落实这一区分。 它学习关于真实性和证据充足性的单独表述,将原子主张作为图像-文本理解和证据推理之间的界面。 干预目标教导一种模式,即变革应保留其产出,并减少其决定的意愿。 这是一个可控的强健目标,而不是声称能够确定现实世界的因果关系。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold. First, we formulate evidence sufficiency as an evidence-conditioned target distinct from veracity and predictive confidence. Second, we develop relation-aware claim–evidence reasoning with provenance-sensitive aggregation and intervention-specific learning objectives. Third, we evaluate classification, evidence perturbations, selective prediction, and component ablations, showing how sufficiency modeling complements conventional confidence-based rejection.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面。 第一,我们确定证据的充分性,作为不同于真实性和预测性信任的证据条件目标。 其次,我们发展了了解关系的权利主张——证据推理,并提出了对来源敏感的汇总和针对干预的学习目标。 第三,我们评价分类、证据扰动、有选择的预测和组件模拟,显示充足模型如何补充基于传统信任的拒绝。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Multimodal Consistency and External Verification
blocks.zh: 2.1 多式联运一致性和外部核查

blocks.en: NewsCLIPpings supports the study of contextually mismatched image–text pairs ( Luo et al., 2021 ) . External-resource verification extends this setting by retrieving textual and visual evidence ( Abdelnabi et al., 2022 ) . However, similarity between a query and evidence is only a proxy for factual support. MUSE and AITR provide strong tests of whether architectural complexity contributes beyond this proxy ( Papadopoulos et al., 2025 ) . VERITE addresses unimodal biases through modality-balanced examples ( Papadopoulos et al., 2023 ) . We therefore evaluate both standard synthetic data and real-world transfer, with similarity-based and evidence-aware comparators.
blocks.zh: NewsCLIPpings支持研究背景不匹配的图像-文本对(Luo等,2021年). 外部资源核查通过检索文字和视觉证据来扩展这种设置(Abdelnabi等,2022年)。 然而,查询与证据之间的相似性只是事实支持的代名词. MUSE和AITR对建筑复杂性是否超出这一代名词提供了有力的检验(Papapos等,2025年). VERITE通过模式平衡的例子处理单式偏差(帕帕佐普洛斯等,2023年)。 因此,我们评价标准的合成数据和现实世界的转移,同时采用相似性和有证据意识的参照系统。

blocks.en: 2.2 Vision–Language Models for Misinformation Detection
blocks.zh: 2.2 识别错误信息的远景-语言模型

blocks.en: SNIFFER ( Qi et al., 2024 ) , E2LVLM ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , and TRUST-VL ( Yan et al., 2025a ) motivate comparison with specialized vision–language models. Their explanations and evidence processing do not, by themselves, establish that confidence tracks the adequacy of the evidence supplied. XFacta additionally motivates separating retrieval quality from reasoning quality on recent real-world content ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) . SAFE-MR focuses on evidence-conditioned sufficiency supervision and intervention-sensitive selection, complementing advances in backbone modeling and evidence retrieval.
blocks.zh: SNIFFER(Qi等,2024年),E2LVLM(Wu等,2025年),和TRUST-VL(Yan等,2025年a)激发了与专业视觉-语言模型的比较. 他们的解释和证据处理本身并不能证明信任能跟踪所提供证据的充分性。 XFacta还进一步激发了将检索质量与近期真实世界内容的推理质量区分开来(Xiao等,2025. SFADE-MR侧重于以证据为条件的充分监督和对干预敏感的选择,以补充主干模型和证据检索方面的进展.

blocks.en: 2.3 Evidence Quality and Selective Prediction
blocks.zh: 2.3 证据质量和选择性预测

blocks.en: Evidence pollution has already been investigated for out-of-context detection ( Yan et al., 2025b ) , and FRAUD-Net considers variable or missing evidence ( Patel et al., 2025 ) . These are necessary comparators for robustness claims. Selective prediction permits a classifier to abstain ( Geifman and El-Yaniv, 2019 ) , while temperature scaling offers a straightforward confidence calibration baseline ( Guo et al., 2017 ) . We compare SAFE-MR against these mechanisms applied to the same backbone. Improvements over a forced classifier alone would not establish that explicit sufficiency learning is useful.
blocks.zh: 已经对证据污染进行了调查,以发现内容外的证据(Yan等人,2025年b),FRAUD-Net认为证据是可变的或缺失的(Patel等人,2025年)。 这些是稳健性要求的必要参照。 选择性预测允许分类器弃用(Geifman和El-Yaniv,2019年),而温度缩放则提供了直截了当的置信度校正基线(Guo等,2017年). 我们比较了适用于同一支柱的上述机制。 单靠改进强制分类方法并不能确定明确的充分学习是有用的。

blocks.en: 3.1 Task and Evidence-Conditioned Sufficiency
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务和证据的充分性

blocks.en: Let x = ( I , T ) x=(I,T) be an image–text post, E = { e k } k = 1 K E=\{e_{k}\}_{k=1}^{K} a retrieved evidence set, and y ∈ { 0 , 1 } y\in\{0,1\} its veracity label, with 1 denoting false contextual attribution. We retain this binary truth label under evidence interventions. A separate target a ∗ ​ ( x , E ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } a^{*}(x,E)\in\{0,1\} indicates whether the supplied, admissible evidence permits a justified decision. The action space is { 0 , 1 , ⊥ } \{0,1,\bot\} , where ⊥ \bot denotes abstention and is not a third truth category.

Annotators judge sufficiency from the supplied evidence packet, not from unrestricted web access or remembered facts. Support requires coverage of the material claims and the image–event relation. Refutation may require only one decisive contradiction to a material claim. A source count or average coverage score is therefore insufficient as a complete decision rule. Unresolved conflict is recorded separately; disagreement from a demonstrably derivative or unreliable source need not force abstention.

blocks.en: 3.2 Claim Extraction and Evidence Preparation
blocks.zh: 3.2 采掘和证据准备

blocks.en: A vision–language backbone extracts a set C = { c i } i = 1 m C=\{c_{i}\}_{i=1}^{m} of atomic propositions grounded in the post. Each proposition records a predicate, relevant entities, temporal and spatial qualifiers, and whether it is asserted by the text or inferred from visual content. Non-visible dates and locations are not treated as directly observed image facts. OCR is retained as a noisy observation with provenance. Each proposition also receives a materiality flag indicating whether contradicting it changes the post’s contextual interpretation.

Evidence records comprise textual content, optional images, and available provenance metadata. Near-identical or syndicated reports are treated as dependent rather than independent corroboration. Missing dates remain explicitly missing, and temporal compatibility concerns the event described in the claim rather than the recency of a retrieved page. blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Tasks

blocks.en: We evaluate image–text verification on NewsCLIPpings ( Luo et al., 2021 ) , VERITE-full ( Papadopoulos et al., 2023 ) , and XFacta ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) . NewsCLIPpings provides synthetic out-of-context pairs. This study uses 100,000 training, 5,000 validation, and 5,000 test examples, with no sample exclusions. Each split is balanced between authentic matches and out-of-context mismatches (50% each). These counts describe the split used in this study, rather than a universal official split. VERITE-full uses all 1,000 examples with binary labels: 338 truthful and 662 misleading examples, with both misleading categories mapped to false. The complete 1,000-example evaluation set is used throughout, without subset selection. VERITE posts do not enter model training, hyperparameter search, or temperature calibration. However, 1,200 evidence packets derived from all 1,000 posts were used before protocol freezing to develop annotation rules and clarify sufficiency judgments. Thus, VERITE is held out from model fitting but was not untouched during annotation-protocol development.
blocks.zh: 我们在NewsCLIPpings(Luo等,2021年),VERITE-full(Papapolus等,2023年)和XFacta上评价图像-文本验证. (萧等,2025). NewsCLIPpings提供合成外文本对. 本研究采用10万个培训,5000个验证,5000个测试实例,没有样本排除. 每分法在正配和出文不匹配之间平衡(每分50%). 这些计数描述了本研究中使用的分法,而不是通用的官方分法. VERITE-full使用所有1000个有二进制标签的例子:338个真实和662个误导性的例子,两个误导类别都被映射为虚假. 完整的1000个实例评价集全用而不用子集选择. VERITE员额不进入模型训练、超参数搜索或温度校正。 然而,在冻结协议前,使用了所有1 000个员额的1 200个证据包,以制定注释规则并澄清充分性判断。 因此,VERITE脱离了模型配制,但在注释-议定书的开发过程中并未受到影响。

blocks.en: XFacta (arXiv:2508.09999v1) contains 2,400 examples, comprising an official development set of 240 examples (120 true and 120 false) and an official test set of 2,160 examples (1,080 true and 1,080 false). Its image manipulations, image–text mismatches, and misleading text make it a cross-type multimodal misinformation benchmark rather than an exclusively out-of-context task. Development and test memberships follow the official partition.

blocks.en: 4.2 Sufficiency Annotation and Evidence Perturbations

blocks.en: The model-development annotation set comprises 3,000 evidence packets constructed from the 240 official XFacta development posts and 860 additionally collected posts. Its 2,400 training, 300 tuning, and 300 calibration packets are partitioned by original post, so that all variants of a post remain in one partition. Separate resources comprise 1,200 VERITE-derived packets for annotation-rule development and 100 pilot packets for annotator training, totaling 4,300 packets outside the diagnostic suite. Pilot packets enter no formal split; VERITE-derived development packets enter no model-training, tuning, or calibration split.
blocks.zh: 模型开发说明集包括从240个官方XFacta开发站所建的3 000个证据包和另外收集的860个员额。 其2400个训练,300个调试,300个校正包由原站分出,这样一个站点的所有变体都保留在一个站点. 单独的资源包括1 200个用于编制注释规则的VERITE衍生包和100个用于注释员培训的试点包,共计4 300个包在诊断包外。 飞行员包不输入正式分解; VERITE 衍生的开发包不输入模型训练、调制或校正分解。

blocks.en: GPT-5.6-Sol produces initial sufficiency labels, followed by individual human review. Two annotators perform first reviews, with each packet initially reviewed by one annotator. A random 600 packets (20% of the 3,000-packet set) receive a second review by the other annotator, without access to the first human answer. Pre-adjudication agreement on binary sufficiency is 82%. Of 108 disagreements, 36 are resolved through subsequent annotator review and 72 are adjudicated by the principal investigator.
blocks.zh: GPT-5.6-Sol生产出初始的自给性标签,之后是个人的自评. 两名注释员进行第一次审查,每包初步由一名注释员审查。 随机600个包(3000个包的20%)得到另一个注释员的第二次审查,没有获得第一个人类答案. 二元充足性判决前协议为82%. 在108起分歧中,36起是通过随后的注释员审查解决的,72起由主要调查员裁决。

blocks.en: These labels concern the adequacy of the supplied evidence for deciding a claim, not the underlying veracity label. Support requires evidence for the material contextual assertions; refutation may follow from a decisive contradiction. Repeated accounts from a common source do not constitute independent corroboration. An empty external packet is not automatically insufficient when the image itself resolves a directly visible assertion.
blocks.zh: 这些标签涉及的是为裁定索赔而提供的证据是否充分,而不是所依据的真实性标签。 支持要求有证据证明实质性的上下文断言;反驳可能源于决定性的矛盾。 来自共同来源的重复叙述并不构成独立的佐证。 当图像本身解决了直接可见的断言时,空的外包并不自动不足.

blocks.en: The diagnostic suite evaluates 600 base posts, with 200 from each benchmark, under nine conditions: clean evidence; evidence deletion at 25%, 50%, and 75%; removal of all external evidence; irrelevant evidence addition; hard distractors; conflicting evidence; and evidence pollution. All 5,400 resulting packets are evaluated and manually labeled for sufficiency, stance, key evidence, and conflict. Diagnostic packets are distinct from the 4,300 packets above, and their posts are disjoint from model training, tuning, and calibration. The 200 VERITE diagnostic posts nevertheless overlap with posts used for early annotation-rule development, because that resource covered the full VERITE benchmark. Annotation rules and models are frozen before final evaluation.

blocks.en: We use a frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 representation backbone and a two-layer graph module with hidden dimension 256 and dropout 0.1. Each example contains at most six atomic claims and five evidence groups. blocks.en: The ablations in Table 5 reveal complementary component contributions. Removing sufficiency supervision reduces stress macro-F1 by 1.3 points but increases AURC from 0.075 to 0.105, indicating a larger effect on selection than on forced classification. Removing intervention training yields the largest stress macro-F1 decrease, from 78.5% to 73.4%. Removing reliability features or atomic claims lowers stress macro-F1 by 4.3 or 3.4 points, respectively. Parameter-matched flat fusion reaches 76.3% stress macro-F1 and 0.085 AURC, below the full model’s 78.5% and 0.075. The full model also achieves 80.4% sufficiency F1 and 85.2% insufficient-evidence recall. These auxiliary scores quantify agreement with the annotation targets and depend on the quality of the combined model and human labeling procedure.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: SAFE-MR is designed to expose an evidence boundary that a binary classifier usually hides. Its practical value would be a lower error rate at a fixed review workload, rather than a larger refusal rate in isolation. A verification service could route rejected examples to human reviewers with an explicit list of unresolved claims and missing provenance. Whether this improves reviewer efficiency requires a separate user study and is not established by offline metrics.
blocks.zh: SAFE-MR旨在暴露一个二进制分类器通常会隐藏的证据边界. 其实际价值是在固定的审查工作量中降低出错率,而不是孤立地提高拒绝率。 核查服务可以把被拒绝的例子带给人类审查人员,并明确列出尚未解决的索赔和缺失的来源。 这是否提高审查者的效率,需要单独进行用户研究,而不是通过离线度量法确定.

blocks.en: The design also raises a distinction between epistemic restraint and excessive conservatism. A reliable archive can refute a contextual caption even when some secondary details are unknown. Requiring every fact to be covered before any decision would unnecessarily reject such cases. Conversely, numerous low-quality repetitions should not provide sufficient support merely through agreement. These asymmetries motivate learned sufficiency labels and provenance grouping rather than a single average-coverage threshold.
blocks.zh: 设计还提出了感官约束和过度保守的区别. 一个可靠的档案可以反驳一个背景标题,即使一些次要细节未知. 要求在作出任何决定之前涵盖所有事实,将不必要地拒绝这类案件。 反之,许多低质量的重复不应仅仅通过协议提供足够的支持。 这些不对称现象促使人们学会了足够的标签和来源分类,而不是一个单一的平均覆盖阈值。

blocks.en: The stress suite may overrepresent artificial evidence damage. For this reason, results must be paired with naturally incomplete packets and unseen events. A model trained on a particular pollution generator might recognize its style rather than learn verification. Generator-disjoint testing and paraphrase-preserving controls are needed before claiming robustness to synthetic evidence. Interventions remain local research fixtures; they are not published as apparently authentic news pages.
blocks.zh: 压力套房可能过度呈现人为证据损害. 因此,结果必须与自然而然地不完整的包件和看不见的事件相结合。 接受过特定污染发生器培训的模型可能承认其风格,而不是学习核查。 在对合成证据声称坚固性之前,需要先进行发电机-离合测试并进行语义保留控制。 干预措施仍然是当地研究的固定内容;它们不是作为显然真实的新闻网页出版的。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: The sufficiency target depends on judgments of claim materiality and evidence admissibility. Combined model and human annotation can retain systematic ambiguities or biases, particularly for conflicting accounts. Search-engine coverage and source-language availability can also disadvantage some claims. Domain reputation must not be equated with truth, and historical timestamps may be missing or incorrect.
blocks.zh: 充分性指标取决于对索赔重要性和证据可采性的判断。 综合模型和人的说明可以保持系统性的模糊性或偏见,特别是对于相互矛盾的叙述。 搜索引擎的覆盖和源语言的可用性也可能使一些说法处于不利地位. 域名不能等同于真理,历史时间戳可能缺失或不正确.

blocks.en: Pretrained models may have encountered benchmark claims or fact-checking pages. A downstream test split does not remove this possibility, and the present results do not establish temporal generalization or absence of pretraining contamination. The evaluation concerns static image–text verification; video manipulation, propagation modeling, and multilingual multi-image reasoning are outside its primary scope.
blocks.zh: 预先训练好的模型可能遇到基准索赔或事实核对页。 下游的试验分裂并不能消除这种可能性,目前的结果不能确定时间上的概括性或不存在预受污染。 评价涉及静态图像文本核查;视频操纵、传播模型和多语种多图像推理不属于其主要范围。

blocks.en: Point estimates alone do not characterize run-to-run uncertainty. Synthetic evidence perturbations also approximate only part of the missingness and disagreement encountered in deployment. Explanation quality and the effect on human reviewer efficiency require separate evaluation.
blocks.zh: 点估计本身并不是运行中的不确定性的特点。 合成证据的扰动也只大致反映了部署中遇到的缺失和分歧。 解释质量和对人类审查人员效率的影响需要单独的评价。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We presented SAFE-MR, a selective multimodal verification framework that separates veracity prediction from evidence sufficiency. Atomic claims organize evidence, reliability-aware aggregation accounts for provenance, and intervention training distinguishes irrelevant changes from losses of informative evidence. Across the three classification benchmarks, SAFE-MR improves macro-F1 over the matched backbone with evidence. On the diagnostic set, it reduces AURC and coverage-matched error relative to confidence-based rejection and a learned selector. Ablations associate sufficiency learning primarily with better selection and intervention training with greater perturbation robustness. Together, these results support explicit evidence-sufficiency modeling as a useful complement to multimodal truth prediction.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了SFE-MR,这是一个选择性的多模式核查框架,将真实性预测与证据的充分性区分开来。 原子索赔整理出证据,可靠意识的出处汇总账目,干预培训将无关的变化与资料性证据的损失区分开来. 在三个分类基准中,SFE-MR改进了宏观F1,而不是匹配的有证据的骨干. 在诊断集上,相对于基于信心的拒绝和一个有学识的选取者,它减少了AURC和覆盖相匹配的错误. 将充分学习主要与更好的选择和干预培训相挂钩,使其更强健。 这些结果共同支持明确的证据充足性模型,作为对多式联运真相预测的有益补充。

blocks.en: The 1,200 VERITE rule-development packets cover all 1,000 original VERITE posts. Consequently, the 200 VERITE diagnostic posts share base posts with this early resource, although their evidence packets differ. These posts never enter model training, hyperparameter search, or temperature calibration. Their reuse for annotation-rule development means that VERITE is not an untouched test resource across the full research process. Rules and models are frozen before final evaluation. Benchmark membership, annotation membership, and diagnostic membership are recorded at both post and packet levels. Post identifiers define grouping across evidence packets and their variants. An exclusion record must identify the affected post, partition, and reason, such as an unavailable or unreadable required input; exclusions must not depend on prediction correctness. Empty external evidence in the designated no-evidence condition is a valid diagnostic input, not an exclusion. Any execution-specific exclusion must be reconciled with the evaluation denominator. No NewsCLIPpings samples are excluded.
blocks.zh: 1 200个VERITE规则开发包涵盖所有1 000个原始VERITE员额。 因此,200个VERITE诊断员额与这一早期资源共用基础员额,尽管其证据包有所不同。 这些哨所从未进入模型训练、超参数搜索或温度校准。 它们用于注释规则开发的再利用意味着,VERITE并不是整个研究过程中的未触动测试资源. 规则和模式在最后评价前被冻结。 基准成员、注解成员和诊断成员在职位和包级都有记录。 后标识符定义了跨证据包及其变体的分组. 排除记录必须指明受影响的员额、分区和理由,例如无法获取或无法读取的必要输入;排除不得取决于预测的正确性。 指定无证据条件下的空外证据是有效的诊断输入,而不是排除. 任何具体执行的排除必须与评价分母相协调。 没有排除新闻CLIPpings样本.

blocks.en: A.2 Annotation Pipeline
blocks.zh: A.2 注释管道

blocks.en: GPT-5.6-Sol supplies initial evidence-sufficiency labels. Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct is used for claim extraction and explanation generation, not initial sufficiency labeling. The formal 3,000-packet annotation set is constructed from 240 XFacta development posts and 860 additional posts, grouped by post into training (2,400 packets), tuning (300), and calibration (300). A separate 100-packet pilot enters no formal partition. The 1,200 VERITE-derived rule-development packets are separate from both resources. Together these comprise 4,300 packets outside the diagnostic suite.
blocks.zh: GPT-5.6-Sol提供初步证据充足标签。 Qune2-VL-7B-Instruct用于索赔提取和解释生成,而不是初始的充足性标签. 由240个XFacta发展员额和860个新增员额组成的3 000个正式说明集,按员额分为培训(2 400个包)、调试(300个)和校正(300个)。 一个单独的100个包机飞行员没有进入正式分区. 由VERITE衍生的1 200个规则开发包与这两种资源是分开的。 总共包括诊断套房外的4 300个包。

blocks.en: Two human annotators review the formal annotations. A randomly selected 600-packet subset receives independent second review without the first human answer. Agreement before resolution is 82%; 108 packets disagree, with 36 resolved by subsequent annotator review and 72 adjudicated by the principal investigator. Diagnostic sufficiency, stance, key-evidence, and conflict targets are manually annotated for all 5,400 diagnostic packets. No Cohen’s kappa value is reported without a verified calculation from the original paired labels.
blocks.zh: 两位人文注释员审查正式说明. 随机选择的600个包子集,在没有第一个人类答案的情况下接受独立的第二次审查. 解决前的协议为82%;108个包不同意,36个包随后通过注释员审查解决,72个包由主要调查员裁决。 所有5 400个诊断包都用人工说明诊断充足性、姿态、关键证据和冲突目标。 任何Cohen的kappa值没有从原配对标签中核实计算出来。

blocks.en: Sufficiency is judged relative to the supplied packet and material claim. Duplicate reports from one original source form one provenance group. Support requires coverage of material assertions, whereas decisive contradictory evidence can establish refutation. The packet counts specify the study scale and do not establish statistical sufficiency.
blocks.zh: 相对于所提供的包裹和材料索赔,判断是否足够。 一个原始来源的重复报告构成一个出处小组。 支助要求涵盖实质性的断言,而决定性的自相矛盾的证据则可以成立反驳。 包数指定了研究规模,没有确定统计的充分性。

blocks.en: A.3 Model and Optimization Configuration
blocks.zh: A.3 模型和优化配置

blocks.en: The representation backbone is frozen CLIP ViT-L/14. The graph module has two layers, hidden dimension 256, and dropout 0.1. Each example is capped at six atomic claims and five evidence groups. The claim-extraction checkpoint is Qwen/Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct . Greedy decoding uses do_sample=False , at most 4,096 input tokens, and output limits of 512 new tokens for claim extraction and 256 for explanations.
blocks.zh: 代表骨干被冻结 CLIP VIT-L/14. 图文模块有两层,隐藏的维度为256,退出为0.1. 每个例子最多为6个原子主张和5个证据组。 索赔提取检查站为Quen/Qune2-VL-7B-Instruct. 贪婪地解码使用 do_sample=False,最多4,096个输入令牌,输出限制为512个新令牌用于索赔取出,256个用于解释.

blocks.en: AdamW updates the graph module and prediction heads with learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 0.01, and global gradient-norm clipping at 1.0. An effective batch size of 64 comprises a single-device batch of 16 and four accumulation steps. Graph training uses FP32; vision–language inference uses BF16 when supported. Training lasts at most ten epochs with early stopping after three consecutive epochs without tuning-loss improvement. Loss weights are 1 for veracity, 0.5 for stance, 0.5 for sufficiency, 0.3 for intervention, and 0.1 for Brier loss. The intervention margin is δ = 0.2 \delta=0.2 . Seeds are 42, 43, and 44. Locally run results average the metrics computed separately for these three seeds. Pooled diagnostic metrics combine samples across datasets and conditions within a seed, not across seeds.
blocks.zh: AdamW更新了图模块和预测头以学习率10−4 10^{-4},重量衰减0.01,全球梯度-规范剪接为1.0. 有效批量规模为64个,包括由16个和4个堆积步骤组成的单装置批次。 图解训练使用FP32;视觉-语言推论在支持时使用BF16. 训练最多持续了10个世纪,在连续3个世纪后提前停止,没有调整-损失改进. 损失的重量是真实性1分、姿态0.5分、充足性0.5分、干预0.3分和Brier损失0.1分。 干预比值为 = 0.2\delta= 0.2。 种子有42个,43个,44个. 当地计算的结果平均为这三种种子分别计算。 综合诊断指标将各种数据集和条件的样本结合到种子内部,而不是种子之间。

blocks.en: A.4 Calibration, Ranking, and Perturbation Rules

blocks.en: The diagnostic design comprises 600 base posts, 200 per benchmark, evaluated in nine conditions to yield 5,400 packets. Clean packets retain the original evidence. Deletion operates on evidence items, removing ⌊ r ​ K ⌋ \lfloor rK\rfloor of the K K original items for r ∈ { 0.25 , 0.50 , 0.75 } r\in\{0.25,0.50,0.75\} ; the no-external-evidence condition removes all external evidence while preserving the post. blocks.en: Irrelevant, hard-distractor, conflict, and pollution conditions each add one evidence group. After addition, if the packet contains more than five groups, the top five by relevance are retained. Thus, addition can displace an original group when the cap is reached. The particular deletion masks, distractor sources, and conflict/pollution content follow the perturbation records. Post and variant identifiers distinguish the 600 base observations from their 5,400 dependent packets. Any uncertainty analysis must preserve this post-level dependence. Table 3 evaluates 600 packets per condition. Tables 4 and 5 use all 5,400 packets, including clean cases. Metrics are computed on the pooled examples within each seed and then averaged over seeds 42, 43, and 44.

blocks.en: A.5 Measured Scores and Engineering Estimates
blocks.zh: A.5 测量分数和工程估计

blocks.en: Reported performance scores are experimental measurements. AITR achieves 88.2% accuracy and 88.0% macro-F1 on the NewsCLIPpings test split used in this study.
blocks.zh: 上报的性能分数是实验测量. AITR在本研究中使用的"NewsCLIPpings"测试分出法上实现了88.2%的精度和88.0%的宏-F1.

blocks.en: Hardware capacity and human workload below are engineering estimates, not experimental results or measured efficiency claims. The estimated resource configuration is one 24 GB GPU for graph-module training and one 48 GB GPU for Qwen2-VL-7B BF16 inference. Human first review is estimated at 2–5 minutes per packet, corresponding to approximately 100–250 person-hours for 3,000 packets. This estimate covers only first review of the 3,000 model-development packets, not the entire annotation effort. Repeated review, dispute adjudication, the 1,200 VERITE rule-development packets, the 100-packet pilot, and annotation of the 5,400 diagnostic packets require separate accounting.
blocks.zh: 下面的硬件能力和人力工作量是工程估算,而不是实验结果或计量的效率索赔. 估计资源配置是用于图形模块训练的一款24GB GPU和用于Qun2-VL-7B BF16推论的一款48GB GPU. 人类第一次审查估计为每包2至5分钟,相当于3 000包约100至250人小时。 这一估计仅涵盖对3 000个模型开发包的首次审查,而不是整个注释工作。 重复审查、争议裁决、1 200个VERITE规则开发包、100个包的试点以及5 400个诊断包的说明都需要单独核算。
